title: Session: Status badges, Badge component, table/card layout, Toggle Group, conventions doc
description:
COMPLETED (this session):

1. Status badges readability: Switched to outline-only style (border + text, no fill) for application status (pending/accepted/rejected) and room status (active/inactive) on Applications Index, Applications Show, Admin Rooms Index.

2. Badge component: Added shadcn-style Badge at resources/js/Components/ui/badge/ with variants default, secondary, destructive, outline, success, warning, danger, muted. Applications and Rooms now use <Badge variant=...> instead of inline spans.

3. Table + card layout: Applications Index and Admin Rooms Index show card layout on small screens and table on md+ by default. Empty state and pagination shared.

4. View toggle: Installed shadcn-svelte toggle-group; added Toggle Group (Auto / Table / Cards) with MonitorSmartphone, Table2, LayoutGrid icons. viewMode state: responsive (default), table, cards. Fixed ToggleGroup.Item to render children (icon + label). Touch-friendly min-h-[44px] on items.

5. Developing conventions doc: Created .cursor/rules/developing-conventions.mdc (Badge usage, status mapping, table+card layout, Toggle Group pattern, tables, forms). Linked in AGENTS.md.

Files: Applications/Index.svelte, Applications/Show.svelte, Admin/Rooms/Index.svelte, Components/ui/badge/, Components/ui/toggle-group/ (incl. toggle-group-item children fix), developing-conventions.mdc, AGENTS.md.

title: Stream A: Applications List + Details (BD-027, 025, 026)
description:
Deliverables:

BACKEND
- ApplicationPolicy: viewAny() and view() for super_admin, staff, admin, counselor (per 05-SECURITY-CONTROLS).
- ApplicationController index(): authorize viewAny; filters (search=name/reference/email, status, date_from, date_to); paginate 15; return applications with reference_number, full_name, email, status, submitted_at, course_preferences (per 08-API-SPEC-PHASE1).
- ApplicationController show(): authorize view; load application with course + appointment relations; return full application payload + courses for labels.
- Base Controller: added AuthorizesRequests trait for $this->authorize().
- Routes: GET /applications -> index (applications.index), GET /applications/{application} -> show (applications.show); both auth + role:super_admin,staff,admin,counselor.

TESTS (tests/Feature/ApplicationListAndDetailsTest.php)
- Authorized role can view applications list (200, Inertia Index, has applications/filters/statuses).
- List respects search filter and status filter.
- Authorized role can view application details (200, Inertia Show, application + courses).
- Show returns 404 for missing application.
- Proctor cannot view list or show (403).
- Unauthenticated redirect to login for list and show.

FRONTEND
- Applications/Index.svelte: props applications, filters, statuses; search + status + date_from/date_to filters; table (reference, name, email, status badge, submitted, link to show); pagination.
- Applications/Show.svelte: props application, courses; sections (personal info, contact, course preferences, status); back link; placeholder disabled buttons for Accept, Reject, Download slip (follow-up bead).

Contracts: 08-API-SPEC-PHASE1, 09-UI-ROUTES-PHASE1, 05-SECURITY-CONTROLS. All 38 tests pass.
